question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A thing that is kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event
solution:
The correct answer is **"Souvenir."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Souvenir"** means a thing that is kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event. (स्‍मृति चिह्न, निशानी (कोई वस्‍तु जो किसी यात्रा-स्‍थल या छुट्टी या विशेष कार्यक्रम की याद दिलाती रहे))

 
 
• **Example**: *I bought a **souvenir**__ from my trip to Paris.*
 
 
 
• It is a noun and pronounced as soo-vuh-neer.
 
• A thing that is kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event is called **"Souvenir."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 1: Panacea** means a solution or remedy for all problems or diseases. (रोग तथा किसी संकटमय परिस्थिति की सभी कठिनाइयों का निवारक; सर्वरोगहर)

 
 
• **Example**: *He believed that exercise was the **panacea**__ for all his health issues.*
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Sinecure** means a position requiring little or no work but giving the holder status or financial benefit. (ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें बहुत कम या कोई काम न हो लेकिन धारक को दर्जा या वित्तीय लाभ मिले)
 __
 
• **Example**:* His job as a consultant was a **sinecure**__ as he hardly had any work to do.*
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Regalia** means the distinctive clothing or ornaments worn by members of a particular group as a symbol of status or authority. (किसी विशेष समूह के सदस्यों द्वारा स्थिति या अधिकार के प्रतीक के रूप में पहने जाने वाले विशिष्ट कपड़े या आभूषण)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The king's **regalia**__ was on display at the museum.*
